resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because candidates from a different parent Aadhaar matched the resident on face while their remaining modalities matched only partially.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must not match another identity. A face match against a different parent Aadhaar, with fingerprint and iris matching only in part, is treated as the same person enrolled under another record, so the applicant and the newer duplicates were cancelled with the oldest retained. The conflicting records must be reconciled through the Regional Office.
